summary: Frontend-only test of the widened '.shell' layout + structured animation system on the 7HUES homepage. Layout width and no-overflow requirements PASS at 1920/1680/1440/1024/768/390 (scrollWidth === clientWidth at every width; .shell rendered width = 1840px on 1920 viewport). All 7 sections + all inner testids (team-member-0..3, whatwedo-point-0..2, deliver-item-0..3, why-item-0..3, experience-0..5, social-post-0..2, journal-card-0..2) present. Mobile menu, nav-book-cta, hero-book-cta, footer-book-cta, /book form (booking-form + booking-submit) all present. HOWEVER a CRITICAL animation regression was found: the SectionHeader Heading (mask-rise H2) never completes its whileInView transition and stays translated 82.8px down (transform: matrix(1,0,0,1,0,82.8), i.e. y='115%') even after the section is scrolled to the middle of the viewport for several seconds. This makes the big section titles ('ABOUT US', 'WHAT WE DO?', 'HOW WE DELIVER?', 'EXPERIENCES', 'FROM THE ROAD', 'JOURNAL') visually MISSING — they sit hidden behind their overflow-hidden mask parent. WhyHues H2 ('WHY 7HUES?') is fine (uses <Heading> directly, transform: none) — so the failure is systematic to headings rendered via SectionHeader. Additionally 3 large MaskImage elements are also stuck at their initial state (clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0) and transform: scale(1.28)) and never reveal (photo-1661318977466, photo-1552306062, photo-1598683308075 hero). This directly violates the requirement: 'after animations complete, ALL headings, body text and images must be fully visible (not stuck hidden/clipped)'. Body Reveal fades and Heading in WhyHues work correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: H2 mask-rise animation never transitions to y:'0%'. Final computed transform stays matrix(1,0,0,1,0,82.8) (=y:115% of 72px height), so titles remain fully hidden behind the parent span's overflow-hidden mask even after the section is scrolled into view and sits center-viewport for >2s. Verified on desktop (1920, 1440) and mobile widths. Affects section-about, section-what-we-do, section-how-we-deliver, section-experiences, section-from-the-road, section-journal.

ui_bugs.issue: Some MaskImage instances remain stuck at initial state (parent clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0) and img transform: scale(1.28)) after the surrounding section is in view. Observed on 3 images: photo-1661318977466 (~1054x791), photo-1552306062 (~1054x1318), photo-1598683308075 (~709x887). Their clip-path never animates to inset(0 0 0% 0), so the image content is invisible. Other MaskImages on the page do reveal correctly (clip-path inset(0 0 0%)), so the animation utility itself works but is not firing/settling for these instances.

issues: Because the H2 title is stuck hidden, there is a large empty band between the '03' overline and the 4 deliverable items — the section reads as broken/unfinished.

action_items: Fix the Heading (mask-rise) component in frontend/src/components/Reveal.js so that when used inside SectionHeader the whileInView transition to y:'0%' actually completes. Possible causes to investigate: (a) framer-motion viewport margin string '-10% 0px -10% 0px' may not be parsed as intended — try margin:'-10%' or use whileInView animate with useInView + useEffect; (b) interaction between Lenis smooth scroll (useLenis) and framer-motion's IntersectionObserver-based useInView — verify Lenis isn't wrapping <html>/<body> in a way that hides scroll from IO; (c) using string percentage 'y: 115%' — try numeric y in px, or use clipPath on the wrapper (like MaskImage) instead of translating the child. WhyHues Heading works because it is rendered in a different context — compare wrappers.

Fix the 3 MaskImage instances that stay at clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0). Same root cause likely — whileInView not firing for these mounted-late/large images. Consider triggerOnce animation via useInView + useEffect fallback that forces final state after mount, and add a safety useEffect that snaps to final state after ~2s to avoid permanently-hidden content.
Add a safety net: after N ms or if prefers-reduced-motion is on, force final resting state (y:0, clipPath 'inset(0 0 0% 0)', opacity 1) so no element can be left invisible.
critical_code_review_comments: Reveal.js Heading: initial={{ y:'115%' }} with only y (no opacity) means if animation stalls the text is offset out of the mask but still opacity 1 — nothing signals brokenness until you inspect transforms. Consider adding a useEffect timeout that force-completes.
MaskImage sets clipPath 'inset(0 0 100% 0)' as initial. If whileInView never fires, the image is completely clipped away. Same safety-net needed.

viewport margin '-10% 0px -10% 0px' — framer-motion's inView margin follows IntersectionObserver rootMargin syntax (top right bottom left with units). This is likely OK but worth normalising to just '-10%' to reduce risk.

MotionConfig reducedMotion='user' is fine, but combined with useLenis (custom scroll) some browsers/setups may report prefers-reduced-motion: reduce for headless envs — this would set initial=final for animations. Since we see initial applied but not final, reducedMotion is probably not the cause here, but worth double-checking.
Body has overflow-x: hidden which correctly suppresses any tiny horizontal bleed — good.

success_rate.frontend: 60% — layout width & overflow PASS on all 6 widths, all sections/testids present, mobile menu + book form present; animation system FAILS for SectionHeader headings and 3 MaskImages (stuck hidden).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Widths & overflow are solid at 1920/1680/1440/1024/768/390 (all scrollWidth===clientWidth). .shell renders at 1840px on 1920 viewport. The regression is animation-only: (1) motion.h2 inside Reveal.js `Heading` (used via SectionHeader) never animates y from 115% to 0% — verify by checking getComputedStyle(el).transform on any '[data-testid=section-*] h2' after scrolling that section to viewport center for >2s; expect 'none' or matrix with ty≈0, actual ty=82.8. (2) MaskImage instances for photo-1661318977466, photo-1552306062, photo-1598683308075 stay at clip-path 'inset(0px 0px 100%)'. Book page has testids booking-form and booking-submit; I did not submit the form this run — please retest booking POST after animation fixes. Preview URL: from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in frontend/.env (https://road-unfolds.preview.emergentagent.com).
rca of the issue: The SectionHeader-rendered <Heading as='h2'> renders motion.h2 with initial={{ y:'115%' }} whileInView={{ y:'0%' }} viewport={{ once:true, margin:'-10% 0px -10% 0px' }}. Empirical observation: transform stays matrix(1,0,0,1,0,82.8) (=115% of 72px) even after the section has been in the viewport center for several seconds — meaning framer-motion's useInView did not fire the enter state. Direct <Heading> usage in WhyHues works, so the utility itself is functional; the failure correlates with SectionHeader (Heading is preceded by a Reveal-wrapped overline in the same parent div). Most likely cause: viewport margin string '-10% 0px -10% 0px' interacts badly with the target's bounding rect (72px tall inside an overflow-hidden span) so the intersection ratio required is never satisfied, OR Lenis smooth-scroll intercepts scroll events preventing IntersectionObserver root recomputation for small elements. Reproduction: open homepage on 1920x1000, scroll section-how-we-deliver to viewport center, wait 3s, inspect querySelector('[data-testid="section-how-we-deliver"] h2') — computed transform will be 'matrix(1,0,0,1,0,82.8)' and the title text will be invisible above the 4 items. Mitigation: (a) simplify viewport margin to '-10%', (b) add an animation-complete safety useEffect that forces final state after ~1.5s regardless of intersection, (c) also set initial opacity:0 and animate opacity:1 so if it stalls it's at least not offset (or animate the wrapper's clipPath like MaskImage instead of translating the child).
